# proxmox_node_disks (Data Source)

Lists the block devices of one node from `/nodes/{node}/disks/list`, sorted by device path. Proxmox wipes devices used by the disk resources.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_node_disks" "node1" {
  node = "pve-1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String) Cluster node.

### Read-Only
